question: Find the average overall rating of players born before 1985 who have the highest potential among all players, and compare this with the average overall rating of the rest of the players born in the same period.

  SELECT pa."XCL_132" AS rating, pa."XCL_133" AS potential

  WHERE SUBSTRING(p."XCL_125", 1, 4) < '1985'
),
gmax AS (
  SELECT MAX(pa."XCL_133") AS max_potential
  FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
)

FROM base AS b, gmax AS g
